items.claim: matchSpacing still counts a gap the snap carried the box into
items.note: The same mistake was in `spacingSnapSource`'s marks and hold check (`packages/guides/src/sources/spacing.ts`), fixed in the same commit with its own test. Placements are still only offered from gaps the box clears where it starts, because an existing test expects that. A's other point, that a gap the box leaves should now be offered, is not done.

items.claim: Add and replace guide ops that change nothing still record an undo step
items.note: `sameGuide` moved out of `useGuides` into `sameGuide.ts`, so the store and the ops use one definition.

items.claim: Spacing tolerance of 1e-6 is absolute, and the 1e-3 and 1e-6 tolerances disagree
items.note: `docs/unruled.md` has an open entry dated 2026-11-11 saying the alignment and spacing tolerances are world lengths, not relative ones, and that whether they should scale is undecided.
`SceneBoundsOptions` now takes `planeOf`, keyed by node id, matching `deriveAlignmentGuides`. It is new API, so its changeset is `minor`.
